full_prompt_en: A square, softly rendered nightscape photograph opens onto a broad indigo sky above a low mountain ridge and a quiet, nearly featureless plain. The sky claims most of the image, its midnight blue changing subtly toward violet and smoky blue rather than becoming a flat black field. Fine white stars are scattered unevenly across it, with some points sharp and others dim enough to merge into the grain. Slightly left of center, a tall, diffuse band of pink-white and lavender light rises from behind the ridge and reaches almost to the top edge. Its edges are feathered and cloudy, so the star field remains visible around and partly through the luminous haze. The mountain line sits below the middle of the frame as a continuous dark silhouette, broken by a shallow central notch where a coral-pink glow collects along the horizon. Below it, the broad foreground is a very dark red-brown expanse with only faint tonal variation and a few tiny remote glints. Near the lower center, a shallow patch of water catches a narrow vertical reflection in rose, peach, and pale orange, connecting the small ground accent to the brighter atmospheric band above. The sky holds delicate pinprick texture while the land stays smooth and subdued; this contrast gives the image depth without adding busy detail. Illumination comes from the soft distant horizon and the diffuse celestial band, leaving the ridge unlit and the foreground in near silhouette. The composition feels immense and still, its large cool upper field balanced by a thin dark boundary and one small warm reflected note below.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅柔和呈现的方形夜景照片铺开大片靛蓝天空，下方是一道低矮山脊和安静、几乎没有细节的平原。天空占据画面大部，午夜蓝微妙地转向紫色与烟蓝色，而不是变成一块平黑。细小白星不均匀地散落其间，有些光点清晰，有些暗到几乎融入颗粒。中心略偏左处，一条高大的粉白与淡紫色漫射光带从山脊后升起，几乎触及上缘。它的边界羽化如云，因此周围及部分光雾之中仍可见星点。山线落在画面中线以下，成为一道连续深暗剪影；中部一道浅缺口使珊瑚粉微光聚在地平线上。下方广阔前景是一片极深的红褐色平面，只有轻微明暗起伏和几颗遥远的细小光点。靠近下方中心，一小片浅水承接玫瑰色、桃色与淡橙色的狭长竖向倒影，将地面的小亮点与上方更明亮的大气光带连起来。天空保有纤细针点纹理，地面则平滑克制；这种对照在不增加繁杂细节的情况下赋予画面纵深。光来自柔和的远方地平线与漫射的星河光带，让山脊不受直接照亮，前景近乎剪影。构图辽阔而静止，宽大的冷色上部由一道细暗边界和下方一处温暖倒影平衡。
style_prompt_en: A softly rendered low-light photographic treatment is built from an expansive indigo and midnight-blue field, a thin near-black horizontal grounding band, and a restrained warm accent near the lower edge. Numerous fine white pinpoints vary in brightness and spacing, giving the broad dark area a delicate granular texture. A tall, slightly off-center veil of mauve, lavender, and pink-white radiance has cloudy, feathered borders rather than a hard outline; its luminous density fades gradually into the cool surrounding color. Small coral and peach notes gather where the dark band meets the brighter area and repeat as a narrow vertical reflection below. The tonal range is compressed into deep shadow except for these softly glowing accents, preserving both spacious negative areas and fine luminous detail. Edges remain crisp only along the dark horizontal divide; the colored light dissolves through a faint atmospheric haze. The composition creates a quiet upward pull from a tiny warm lower mark through a low central glow into the taller diffuse light, ending in an impression of immense stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和呈现的低光摄影处理以宽阔靛蓝和午夜蓝色域、一道近黑的细水平压底色带，以及靠近下缘的克制暖色点缀构成。许多细小白色针点在亮度和间距上变化，使广阔暗色区域具有纤细颗粒纹理。一层略微偏离中心的淡紫、丁香紫与粉白色高竖光雾，边界如云羽化，没有硬轮廓；发光密度逐渐隐入周围冷色。少量珊瑚色与桃色在暗带接触亮区的位置聚合，并于下方作为狭窄竖向倒影重复。除了这些柔和发光处，明暗范围压缩在深影里，既保留宽阔负空间，也保留细致亮点。边缘只在深暗水平分界处清楚；彩光则溶进淡淡空气雾。构图从下方一小处暖色标记，经由低位中央微光，引向更高的漫射光带，形成安静的向上牵引，最终留下辽阔静止的感觉。
theme_en: A star-filled mountain night above a dark plain and a small reflective pool
theme_zh: 繁星山夜下的深暗平原与小片反光水洼
name: Starlit
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
